verses.text: A song of ascents. I lift up my eyes to the hills. From where does my help come?

xrefs.text: A song of ascents. In my distress I cried to the LORD, and He answered me.
A song of ascents. I lift up my eyes to You, the One enthroned in heaven.
Surely deception comes from the hills, and commotion from the mountains. Surely the salvation of Israel is in the LORD our God.

And many peoples will come and say: “Come, let us go up to the mountain of the LORD, to the house of the God of Jacob. He will teach us His ways so that we may walk in His paths.” For the law will go forth from Zion, and the word of the LORD from Jerusalem.
“I have installed My King on Zion, upon My holy mountain.”

verses.text: My help comes from the LORD, the Maker of heaven and earth.

xrefs.text: For I am the LORD your God, who takes hold of your right hand and tells you: Do not fear, I will help you.
Our help is in the name of the LORD, the Maker of heaven and earth.
So we say with confidence: “The Lord is my helper; I will not be afraid. What can man do to me?”
Do you not know? Have you not heard? The LORD is the everlasting God, the Creator of the ends of the earth. He will not grow tired or weary; His understanding is beyond searching out.
Blessed is he whose help is the God of Jacob, whose hope is in the LORD his God,

verses.text: He will not allow your foot to slip; your Protector will not slumber.

xrefs.text: for the LORD will be your confidence and will keep your foot from the snare.
Then you will go on your way in safety, and your foot will not stumble.
He guards the steps of His faithful ones, but the wicked perish in darkness; for by his own strength shall no man prevail.
They will lift you up in their hands, so that you will not strike your foot against a stone.
He preserves our lives and keeps our feet from slipping.

verses.text: Behold, the Protector of Israel will neither slumber nor sleep.

xrefs.text: A song of ascents. Of Solomon. Unless the LORD builds the house, its builders labor in vain; unless the LORD protects the city, its watchmen stand guard in vain.
I, the LORD, am its keeper; I water it continually. I guard it night and day so no one can disturb it;
You are my hiding place. You protect me from trouble; You surround me with songs of deliverance. Selah
When I applied my mind to know wisdom and to observe the task that one performs on the earth— though his eyes do not see sleep in the day or even in the night—
At noon Elijah began to taunt them, saying, “Shout louder, for he is a god! Perhaps he is deep in thought, or occupied, or on a journey. Perhaps he is sleeping and must be awakened!”

verses.text: The LORD is your keeper; the LORD is the shade on your right hand.

xrefs.text: For You have been a refuge for the poor, a stronghold for the needy in distress, a refuge from the storm, a shade from the heat. For the breath of the ruthless is like rain against a wall,
He who dwells in the shelter of the Most High will abide in the shadow of the Almighty.
I have set the LORD always before me. Because He is at my right hand, I will not be shaken.
And the LORD went before them in a pillar of cloud to guide their way by day, and in a pillar of fire to give them light by night, so that they could travel by day or night.
Then the LORD will create over all of Mount Zion and over her assemblies a cloud of smoke by day and a glowing flame of fire by night. For over all the glory there will be a canopy,

verses.text: The sun will not strike you by day, nor the moon by night.

xrefs.text: ‘Never again will they hunger, and never will they thirst; nor will the sun beat down upon them, nor any scorching heat.’
They will not hunger or thirst, nor will scorching heat or sun beat down on them. For He who has compassion on them will guide them and lead them beside springs of water.
You will not fear the terror of the night, nor the arrow that flies by day,
As the sun was rising, God appointed a scorching east wind, and the sun beat down on Jonah’s head so that he grew faint and wished to die, saying, “It is better for me to die than to live.”

verses.text: The LORD will guard you from all evil; He will preserve your soul.

xrefs.text: And the Lord will rescue me from every evil action and bring me safely into His heavenly kingdom. To Him be the glory forever and ever. Amen.
Because you have made the LORD your dwelling— my refuge, the Most High—
The LORD will protect and preserve him; He will bless him in the land and refuse to give him over to the will of his foes.
No harm befalls the righteous, but the wicked are filled with trouble.
The LORD preserves all who love Him, but all the wicked He will destroy.

verses.text: The LORD will watch over your coming and going, both now and forevermore.

xrefs.text: You will be blessed when you come in and blessed when you go out.
to guard the paths of justice and protect the way of His saints.
in all your ways acknowledge Him, and He will make your paths straight.
Blessed be the name of the LORD both now and forevermore.
On the twelfth day of the first month we set out from the Ahava Canal to go to Jerusalem, and the hand of our God was upon us to protect us from the hands of the enemies and bandits along the way.
